answer: Because the timing is recorded against the ferrous challenge, the plume audit can replay the anchor history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm thus has to pad 122 submissions and hold every participant open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 3568 identities would post 4259 proofs and burn roughly 82 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
